# Techo Labs — Complete AI & Knowledge Graph Reference (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Organization & Corporate Structure
**Techo Labs** ("The Digital Brain of the Techo Ecosystem") is a global digital engineering, AI search growth, and strategic market intelligence studio established in 2021 in Batticaloa, Sri Lanka.

**Corporate Hierarchy**:
- **Parent Company**: **Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd** — https://www.techotraders.com.lk/ (The sole incorporated `(Pvt) Ltd` parent entity).
- **Child Divisions under Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd**:
  1. **Techo Labs** — https://labs.techotraders.com.lk/ (Web & product engineering, SEO/AEO/GEO/AIO/SXO search marketing, and market intelligence).
  2. **Techo Connect** — https://www.connect.techotraders.com.lk/ (Antenna manufacturing and telecommunications hardware infrastructure; digital presence powered by Techo Labs).
  3. **Techo Xpress** — https://www.express.techotraders.com.lk/ (Express courier and smart logistics; live shipment tracking and booking software engineered by Techo Labs).

- **Email**: labs@techotraders.com.lk
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +94 76 665 6007
- **Operating Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 08:00 – 19:00 (GMT+5:30), with global sprint coverage across North America, Europe, UK, and MENA.
- **Primary Regions Served**: Canada, Netherlands, United Kingdom, France, United Arab Emirates, Australia, Sri Lanka, United States.

## 2. 2027 Search & Experience Optimization Methodology (SEO · AEO · GEO · AIO · SXO)
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimization)**: React Server Components (RSC), clean semantic HTML5, Core Web Vitals (<0.8s LCP, <50ms INP, 0.00 CLS), XML sitemaps, canonical hygiene, and topical authority.
- **AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)**: Direct-answer summary blocks, conversational FAQPage JSON-LD, SpeakableSpecification markup, and structured definitions optimised for voice assistants and zero-click featured snippets.
- **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)**: Verifiable benchmarks, structured HTML comparison tables, clear entity relationships (`parentOrganization`, `subOrganization`, `sameAs`, `OfferCatalog`), and authoritative citations tailored for ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- **AIO (AI Optimization)**: Dedicated `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` machine-readable endpoints plus explicit `robots.txt` permissions welcoming GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended.
- **SXO (Search Experience Optimization)**: Instant visual hierarchy, interactive Bento + Ledger portfolio exploration, transparent engagement models, and 1-click consultation pathways via form or WhatsApp.

## 3. Core Engines & Engagement Models

### Engine 01. Next-Gen Web & Product Engineering (2–8 Weeks)
- Next.js & React Server Component Web Applications
- Bespoke 2027 UI/UX Design Systems & Interactive Prototyping
- Headless & Hybrid CMS (Sanity, Strapi, WordPress)
- High-Conversion E-Commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce, Custom Storefronts)
- Custom SaaS Dashboards, APIs & Logistics Tracking Software

### Engine 02. Omnichannel Growth & AI Search (90-Day Sprints)
- Technical & Content SEO + AEO + GEO + AIO + SXO Execution
- Google Search, Performance Max & Display Advertising (PPC)
- Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Full-Funnel Paid Social
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & GA4 Attribution

### Engine 03. Market & Competitive Intelligence (2–4 Weeks)
- Competitor Teardowns & Digital Moat Benchmarking
- Total Addressable Market (TAM) & Regional Demand Sizing
- Buyer Persona Research, User Interviews & Go-To-Market Playbooks
